request: Compare the termination provisions and draft one reconciled replacement clause.
source_text: D1 permits termination for material breach after a 30-day cure period. D2 permits immediate termination for any breach.

documents.text: Termination. Either party may terminate for material breach if the breach remains uncured for thirty days after written notice.
Termination. Supplier may terminate immediately upon any breach by Customer.

request: Compare the liability provisions and draft a coherent replacement with unresolved business choices clearly bracketed.
source_text: D1 caps aggregate liability at fees paid during the prior twelve months. D2 excludes indirect damages but provides no aggregate cap.

documents.text: Limitation of Liability. Aggregate liability shall not exceed fees paid under this Agreement during the twelve months preceding the claim.
Damages Exclusion. Neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages. No aggregate liability cap is stated.

request: Compare the notice provisions and draft one coherent replacement that leaves the delivery-method choice open for the parties.
source_text: D1 requires certified mail to stated addresses. D2 permits email notice when receipt is confirmed.

documents.text: Notices must be sent by certified mail, return receipt requested, to the addresses stated in this Agreement.
